Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.42 fixes a cross-mod sleep deadlock where another mod cancelling EndOfDayUIManager.OnEndDayButtonClick (such as a Day-7 intro/background prompt, after-hours story, or room bed confirmation) left Eleanor's sleepStarting flag stuck and blocked all subsequent sleep attempts; hides the early-close confirmation panel when a closing CG window dialogue starts; clears departing closed-shutter customers before bedtime window dialogues so the 4-second shutter timer cannot abort them; and releases window locks on premature EndConversation(). All 1.41/1.40/1.39/1.38 fixes and content remain. 1.42 修复与其他 MOD 共用时，对方在睡前拦截结束当天按钮（如第 7 天剧情背景提示、闭店后剧情或房间床铺确认）导致本 MOD 的睡眠状态锁死、后续无法睡觉与推进天数的问题；闭店前 CG 窗口对白触发时自动隐藏提前闭店确认弹窗；关门后 4 秒内立即睡觉时先清理正在离店的客人，防止延迟定时器打断睡前对白；补充异常提前结束对话时的状态释放与晨间兜底复位。保留 1.41/1.40/1.39/1.38 全部内容与修复。简体中文 / English / 日语 / 韩语 (ZH / EN / JA / KO)。
